Hi Sara, Evan —

Thanks for taking time to speak this morning. Per our conversation, we'd like to kick off a short alignment thread to capture the GCP Marketplace registration steps, co-sell enablement requirements, and the procurement/billing path Acme will use for initial pilots. High level asks from our side: 

- Confirm whether Acme will use GCP billing (marketplace metered/subscription) vs direct invoicing for the pilot.
- Provide the exact list of documentation GCP needs for listing (legal, technical, SOC2 evidence).
- Confirm co-sell registration timeline and any partner-ops forms we should complete.

Attached: redwood-gcp-pricing-matrix.xlsx (pricing bands for pilot), MVP-sow-v2.docx (proposal), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary).

Next steps I propose: Sara provides partner-ops checklist, Acme confirms billing preference by Tue 24 May, Rishi and Marissa will draft the procurement handoff doc and HubSpot record.

Thanks —
Vanessa
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Le <sara.le@google.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Evan Liu <evan.liu@acme-ai.com>
Cc: PartnerOps <partnerops@google.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace registration & billing pathway kickoff

Thanks Vanessa — good to meet both of you. Quick answers and next steps from Partner Ops: 

1) Billing model: GCP supports both Marketplace billing (Google pays vendor and bills customer, or metered/subscription flows) and direct billing (vendor invoices customer). For pilots we usually recommend Marketplace metered if the customer is already a GCP billing account — it simplifies procurement on their side.

2) Required docs for listing: W-9 or W-8 (tax), proof of identity, SOC 2 summary (the full SOC2 can be requested later), a support contact, and a product tile + technical manifest. Partner Ops also needs an internal partner profile filled: I will share the form.

3) Co-sell: please complete the Partner Co-sell Registration form (I attached a link below). Co-sell approval typically takes 5–10 business days after form + listing artifacts are submitted.

Action items: I will send the Partner Ops checklist and a DocuSign PowerForm for the partner profile by EOD. Evan — let us know if Acme prefers Marketplace billing or direct invoicing by Tue 24 May.

Best,
Sara
GCP Partner Manager
